title: Filipino-Style Stew
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew inspired by Filipino cuisine, made with savory and spicy flavors, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add poblano peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add potatoes, carrots, and bell pepper. Stir to combine.
Add soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce (if using). Stir to combine.
Pour in enough water to cover the vegetables.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (optional).
